subject: Deployment regression: request for downtime certification, apportionment, and post-incident evidence
messages:
From: Felix Moreno <felix@novacart.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: operations@novacart.com
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 22:14:00 -0000
Subject: production regression — 2027-01-22 21:35 UTC service gap

Mina,

We saw a clear availability gap tonight during our peak window (approx 21:35–21:52 UTC) where our checkout calls to your hosted endpoint returned 503/504s and several requests timed out. Our monitors show a 27% error rate on the 21:35–21:52 interval and downstream retries amplified the user impact.

We need confirmation of the exact downtime interval from your side, a statement on whether this qualifies for SLA apportionment, and the steps to request any compensatory credit if eligible.

I've attached a short error snippet and our signed incident request form to speed things along.

Attaching: novacart_error_snippet.txt, novacart_request_form_signed.pdf

Thanks — Felix
Felix Moreno
Head of Platform, Novacart
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Felix Moreno <felix@novacart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 23 Jan 2027 01:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: production regression — 2027-01-22 21:35 UTC service gap

Thanks Felix — and thanks for the attachments. We're escalating internally and will pull the timeline and raw traces for the interval you flagged. Two quick asks to help speed the evidence pull:

- Can you confirm the tenant ID you saw the errors under (customer-acc: NOVA-4821) and a couple representative request IDs if available?
- Were you routed to our hosted.frontend region (us-west-2) or a different region? Your monitoring suggests us-west-2 but I'd like confirmation.

Internal note to Marissa/Jonas: please start a telemetry extraction for NOVA-4821 covering 2027-01-22T21:00Z to 2027-01-23T00:00Z; include request traces, per-route success rates, and autoscaler logs. If there was any deployment at ~21:30 UTC in us-west-2 please flag.

I'll confirm next steps and whether this meets SLA remediation criteria once we have the raw traces. ETA for an initial evidence packet: 36 hours.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 23 Jan 2027 03:40:00 -0000
Subject: Re: production regression — evidence pull in progress

Looping in Laura for contract/credit guidance. Telemetry team: I've requested an extraction (job #EX-20270123-77) and an ops engineer will validate the sequence. Early check: there was a canary rollout at 21:20 UTC to a small pool in us-west-2 to address a perf regression — we saw an elevated error rate on the new variant which triggered an automated rollback at 21:50 UTC.

If rollback timing aligns with their window, this looks like a deployment-induced regression that impacted their tenant. We should plan to:

1) Provide a certified availability window (exact start/end) and a bundle of raw traces.
2) Recommend a proportional credit calculation (per the SLA apportionment clause) — Laura, propose a framework for a partial credit.
3) Offer a postmortem invite and an ops runbook review with Novacart.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success
From: Felix Moreno <felix@novacart.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 24 Jan 2027 08:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: production regression — 2027-01-22 21:35 UTC service gap

Thanks — confirming tenant ID is NOVA-4821. Representative request IDs: r_20270122_21_38_119, r_20270122_21_40_502. We are positive requests were routed to us-west-2.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Please include KV cache eviction logs in the extract if present — our team saw increased latency right before the spike.
- We need a confirmed SLA window (start/end) and an interim estimate of any pro-rata credit you expect so we can begin internal accounting.

Felix
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Felix Moreno <felix@novacart.com>
Date: Sun, 24 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: production regression — proposed apportionment and next steps

Felix / Novacart team — thanks for the representative IDs. Based on the telemetry extraction and our rollback timing, our provisional certified downtime interval is 2027-01-22T21:36:00Z to 2027-01-22T21:49:00Z (13 minutes). This is subject to final verification of trace continuity and KV cache correlation, but it's the interval we'll use for an initial apportionment.

Preliminary credit approach (provisional):
- Per your monthly uptime SLA, a 13-minute partial outage during peak maps to a proportional credit equal to 0.9% of monthly service fees for the affected scope (checkout endpoints).
- We'll reserve the right to adjust if log reconciliation changes the effective duration.

Next steps:
1) Ops will deliver a redacted log bundle and the trace packet by EOD Monday (job EX-20270123-77).
2) We'll schedule a post-incident review (30–45 minutes) week of 2027-01-25; proposed times attached.
3) If you accept the provisional credit, Finance will prepare a credit memo; if not, we'll carry on to full RCA and final adjudication.

Attachments: postmortem_time_options.

— Laura Bennett
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
